text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“—Don't go tellin' me ya don't remember
the carrot patch on this back o' mine!”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... I guess I was half-asleep.
Forget it, please forget it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was watching my favorite period dramas during my break,
and I just got a little too carried away with it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even in my dreams...
the back-and-forth in the magistrate's court went on... *yaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute
wasn't able to rest well.
